metadata.source: Google Maps browser capture via MCP Playwright
metadata.scope: Direct adjacent District line station pairs derived from static graph edges
notes: This file stores Monday 8am Google Maps reference times for direct District line station pairs so future work does not need to re-query Google Maps.
Pairs with no District option remain in the dataset with captureStatus set to no-district-option-found.
These values are kept separate from public/data/static-tube-times.json, which remains the app internal graph dataset.
